title: funcd security kind: flow dir: down
[Ask RBAC] red down api: API | control-plane writes edge: Edge | authenticated Routes [/] [Ask Cedar] red 2 local: Local API | stores, Secrets, calls, runs proxy: Add-on proxy | engine calls s3: S3 gateway | Buckets lakegw: Lake gateway | queries egress: Egress gateway | outbound connections [/] rbacq: RBAC allows? | admin, developer, viewer @purple cedarq: Cedar allows? | data-plane actions @purple [Cedar's rules] amber right policy: Policy | Cedar text roles: RolesAssignment | Roles at a scope egresspol: EgressPolicy | allowed destinations [/]
Ask RBAC > rbacq Ask Cedar > cedarq cedarq ~> Cedar's rules: reads
